notes:
BUILD 50
- Armour rebalanced so tiers mean something. Protection no longer simply adds up to the cap: a mixed set of light gear (helmet, road sign jacket, pants, gloves) now gives about 60% bullet protection instead of 85%. A full metal set (facemask, chest plate and the rest) still reaches 85%, and the full heavy plate set reaches 90%. Burlap is around 15%.
